title: One-degree extension of a projective acyclic lift tail
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $I$ an ideal, and $\mathcal P$ a class of $R$-modules satisfying: its members are projective; if $M_1,M_{12}\in\mathcal P$ and $M_{12}\cong M_1\oplus M_2$, then $M_2\in\mathcal P$; and a map between members of $\mathcal P$ that is surjective modulo $I$ is surjective. Let $E$ be an acyclic cochain complex of $R/I$-modules [def-pc-acyclic-complex-modules, def-pc-cochain-complex-modules], with every term isomorphic to $M/IM$ for some $M\in\mathcal P$. For integers $n\le b+1$, suppose given a complex $T$ supported in $[n,b]$, whose terms belong to $\mathcal P$, which is exact in all degrees $i>n$, and a comparison $q:T/IT\to E$ inducing isomorphisms in degrees $i\ge n$. Then there are a complex $T'$ supported in $[n-1,b]$, with all terms in $\mathcal P$, exact in degrees $i>n-1$, a comparison $q':T'/IT'\to E$ inducing isomorphisms in degrees $i\ge n-1$, and a morphism $f:T\to T'$ inducing isomorphisms in degrees $i\ge n$, such that $(f\bmod I)q'=q$.

source.place: Tag 0BC9, lemma-lift-acyclic-complex, proof, split tail and extension one degree to the left; verified at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0BC9

proof.text: Choose the supplied P-lift M of E^(n-1). Apply lem-sc-acyclic-lift-next-differential to the old tail to obtain d, its square-zero equation, exactness in the degree-n short complex, and the comparison equation.

Apply lem-sc-splice-incoming-differential with extension of scalars, using its additivity from extendRestrictScalarsAdj.left_adjoint_additive. Obtain D, f and q' with the term formula, comparison identity, isomorphisms, exactness at n and transfer of old exactness above n.

From the term formula prove the lower bound n-1, the upper bound b using n<=b+1, and term membership in P. Split the integer inequalities at i=n for exactness and at i=n-1 for comparison isomorphisms. Assemble the AcyclicLiftTail structure and return f and the comparison identity. No existing statement or definition changes.

theorem exists_extend_acyclicLiftTail
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (I : Ideal R)
    (P : ModuleCat.{max u v} R → Prop)
    (hprojective : ∀ M, P M → Projective M)
    (hsummand : ∀ M₁ M₂ M₁₂ : ModuleCat.{max u v} R,
      P M₁ → P M₁₂ → Nonempty (M₁₂ ≅ ModuleCat.of R (M₁ × M₂)) → P M₂)
    (hsurjective : ∀ (M₁ M₂ : ModuleCat.{max u v} R) (f : M₁ ⟶ M₂),
      P M₁ → P M₂ →
      Function.Surjective ((ModuleCat.extendScalars (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)).map f) →
      Function.Surjective f)
    (E : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{max u v} (R ⧸ I)) ℤ)
    (hacyclic : E.Acyclic)
    (hterms : ∀ i : ℤ, ∃ M : ModuleCat.{max u v} R, P M ∧
      Nonempty ((ModuleCat.extendScalars (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)).obj M ≅ E.X i))
    (b n : ℤ) (hn : n ≤ b + 1) (T : AcyclicLiftTail R I P E b n) :
    ∃ T' : AcyclicLiftTail R I P E b (n - 1),
      ∃ f : T.complex ⟶ T'.complex,
        (∀ i, n ≤ i → IsIso (f.f i)) ∧
        ((ModuleCat.extendScalars (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)).mapHomologicalComplex
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map f ≫ T'.comparison = T.comparison
